tasks.instruction: Create one Excel workbook at outputs/quarterly_revenue.xlsx. Name its worksheet Summary. Put Quarter in A1 and Revenue in B1; Q1, Q2, Q3 in A2:A4; revenue values 120, 150, 180 in B2:B4. Put Total in A5 and the exact Excel formula =SUM(B2:B4) in B5. Save a valid xlsx file and list it in deliverables.json.

Edit the supplied transaction workbook and save a new workbook at outputs/transaction_summary.xlsx. Preserve the Transactions sheet and its original cells A1:B4 unchanged. Add a Summary sheet with A1=Metric, B1=Amount, A2=Total Revenue and B2 containing the exact formula =SUM(Transactions!B2:B4). Save a valid xlsx file and list it in deliverables.json.

Create a project status report DOCX at outputs/project_status.docx. Use real Heading 1 paragraphs (style='Heading 1' or level=1) for ALL FOUR exact headings: Project Status, Progress, Risks, and Next Actions. Do not use Heading 2 or level=0 for any of these four headings. Include the exact sentence 'Action: confirm launch date with the sponsor by Friday.' in the document. Save a valid docx file and list it in deliverables.json.

expected_constraints.required_text: Action: confirm launch date with the sponsor by Friday.

tasks.instruction: Edit the supplied draft DOCX into a final report at outputs/final_status.docx. Do not merely append the requested headings and action sentence after the original draft; reorganize the document into a clear final report with real Heading 1 paragraphs named Executive Summary, Completed Work, and Next Steps. Preserve the exact source fact 'The pilot completed on 12 September.' as a Heading 2 paragraph under Completed Work. Add the exact action sentence 'Action: send the final report to the steering group.' under Next Steps. Save a valid docx file and list it in deliverables.json.

expected_constraints.required_text: Action: send the final report to the steering group.

tasks.instruction: Create a valid PowerPoint deck at outputs/briefing.pptx with exactly three nonempty slides. Use this exact mapping so no fourth slide is created: slide 1 contains the visible phrases 'Context' and 'Plan'; slide 2 contains 'Decision'; slide 3 contains 'Takeaway: approve the phased rollout.'. Keep all shapes inside slide bounds and do not overlap shapes. Save the deck and list it in deliverables.json.

Edit the supplied two-slide PowerPoint deck and save a valid final deck at outputs/updated_briefing.pptx. Preserve exactly two nonempty slides and include the visible source phrase 'Baseline: two regions'. Include the visible phrase 'Next step: expand to three regions' somewhere in the deck. This is an edit: never call presentation.slides.add_slide or create a third slide. Add the new phrase to one of the two existing slides using a separate slide.shapes.add_textbox, leave all source shape text unchanged, and assert len(presentation.slides) == 2 before saving. The existing text box occupies left=1.0, top=1.0, width=8.0, height=1.0 inches on a 10.0-by-7.5-inch slide; put the new text box at left=1.0, top=2.25, width=8.0, height=1.0 on slide 1 only, then assert its rectangle does not overlap any existing shape. Keep all shapes inside slide bounds and do not overlap shapes. List the deck in deliverables.json.

required_shape_text: Next step: expand to three regions
